newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal Telecom to change pricing in Jan.
newsitem.headline: Portugal Telecom to change pricing in Jan.

text.p: Portugal Telecom plans to cut the price of inter-city and international calls and raise the price of local and regional calls from January, a spokesman said.
He said the exact changes in prices of phone calls had yet to be defined and that there was no precise date yet for the implementation of the changes.
The spokesman told Reuters that the prices were reviewed as part of a tariff agreement between PT, the Portuguese Institute of Communications and the Directorate-General for Competition and Prices.
"PT is trying to create a better balance for the consumer in terms of pricing and to bring costs more into line with Europe," the spokesman said.
He said local and regional calls in Portugal, which account for 40 percent of the total volume of calls using PT, were among the cheapest in Europe.
